<h1 id="jetlinks">Jetlinks</h1>
<p>Jetlinks 是一个非常优秀物联网基础平台, 还支持开源二次开发, 且他们的开发团队还非常友好的, 即使你使用的是开源的版本还挺愿意帮你解决问题 <s>(当然我司也购买了企业版, 但不能分享学习笔记)</s></p>
<h2 id="文档地址">文档&amp;地址</h2>
<p><a href="https://github.com/jetlinks/jetlinks-community" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">社区版源码仓库</a><br>
<a href="https://gitee.com/jetlinks/jetlinks-ui-antd" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">前端源码 gitee</a><br>
<a href="https://github.com/jetlinks/jetlinks-ui-antd.git" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">前端源码 github</a></p>
<p><a href="http://doc.jetlinks.cn/install-deployment/start-with-source.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">文档-源码启动</a><br>
<a href="http://doc.jetlinks.cn/Device_access/Configuration_model3.4.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">文档2-物模型</a><br>
<a href="https://hanta.yuque.com/px7kg1/nn1gdr/ldfh0gfyua041osv#PcBDb" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">新文档-协议开发</a></p>

<h1 id="设备接入">设备接入</h1>
<p>设备接入流程图<br>
<img alt="device-flow.fd9a8a41" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3723410/202511/3723410-20251128211710168-1233896453.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1 id="网络--协议--网关">网络 &gt; 协议 &gt; 网关</h1>
<h2 id="网络组件-orgjetlinkscommunitynetworknetwork">网络组件 (org.jetlinks.community.network.Network)</h2>
<p>真正与设备连接交互的网络层, <strong>用于管理各种网络服务(MQTT,TCP等),动态配置, 启停. 只负责接收/发送报文,不负责任何处理逻辑。</strong></p>
<p>社区版, 网络组件的实现有四类:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.tcp.server.TcpServer</code> // 作为服务器接受设备端连接</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.tcp.client.TcpClient</code> // 主动tcp连接设备端</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.mqtt.client.MqttClient</code> //使用客户端连接第三方的MQTT服务器</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.mqtt.server.MqttServer</code> //使用的本机MQTT服务, 接受设备端连接</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>网络组件, 支持提供关键的两个接口</p>
<ol>
<li><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.Network</code></li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">public interface Network {
    /**
     * ID唯一标识
     *
     * @return ID
     */
    String getId();

    /**
     * @return 网络类型
     * @see DefaultNetworkType
     */
    NetworkType getType();

    /**
     * 关闭网络组件
     */
    void shutdown();

    /**
     * @return 是否存活
     */
    boolean isAlive();

    /**
     * 当{@link Network#isAlive()}为false是,是否自动重新加载.
     * @return 是否重新加载
     * @see NetworkProvider#reload(Network, Object)
     */
    boolean isAutoReload();
}
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.NetworkProvider</code></li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">public interface NetworkProvider&lt;P&gt; {
    /**
     * @return 类型
     * @see DefaultNetworkType
     */
    @Nonnull
    NetworkType getType();

    /**
     * 使用配置创建一个网络组件
     * @param properties 配置信息
     * @return 网络组件
     */
    @Nonnull
    Network createNetwork(@Nonnull P properties);

    /**
     * 重新加载网络组件
     * @param network    网络组件
     * @param properties 配置信息
     */
    void reload(@Nonnull Network network, @Nonnull P properties);

    /**
     * @return 配置定义元数据
     */
    @Nullable
    ConfigMetadata getConfigMetadata();

    /**
     * 根据可序列化的配置信息创建网络组件配置
     * @param properties 原始配置信息
     * @return 网络配置信息
     */
    @Nonnull
    Mono&lt;P&gt; createConfig(@Nonnull NetworkProperties properties);
    ...
</code></pre>
<ol>
<li>每一个网络组件(<code>org.jetlinks.community.network.Network</code>) 对应有一个组件提供器对应 (<code>org.jetlinks.community.network.NetworkProvider</code>)</li>
<li>最终网络组件统一由 <code>org.jetlinks.community.network.NetworkManager</code> 管理;</li>
<li>默认实现是<code>org.jetlinks.community.network.DefaultNetworkManager</code>(用Spring BeanPostProcessor hook 加载的)</li>
<li>调用其<code>org.jetlinks.community.network.DefaultNetworkManager#register</code>方法, 传递 NetworkProvider 可以注册一个网络组件</li>
<li>实例组件数据是存在数据库的 <code>network_config</code> 表</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="协议相关-orgjetlinkscoreprotocolsupport">协议相关 (org.jetlinks.core.ProtocolSupport)</h2>
<p><strong>用于自定义消息解析规则,用于认证、将设备发送给平台报文解析为平台统一的报文，以及处理平台下发给设备的指令。</strong></p>
<p>协议(<code>org.jetlinks.core.ProtocolSupport</code>)主要由: <code>认证器(Authenticator)</code>, <code>消息编解码器(DeviceMessageCodec)</code>,<code>消息发送拦截器(DeviceMessageSenderInterceptor)</code> 以及<code>配置元数据(ConfigMetadata)</code>组成.</p>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.core.defaults.Authenticator</code> // Authenticator<br>
<code>org.jetlinks.core.codec.defaults.DeviceMessageCodec</code> //DeviceMessageCodec<br>
<code>org.jetlinks.core.message.interceptor.DeviceMessageSenderInterceptor</code> //DeviceMessageSenderInterceptor<br>
<code>org.jetlinks.core.ProtocolSupport</code> + <code>org.jetlinks.core.metadata.DeviceMetadataCodec</code> //ConfigMetadata</p>
<p>其默认自带的<code>JetLinks V1.0</code> 协议,在<code>org.jetlinks.supports.official.JetLinksProtocolSupportProvider</code> 提供</p>
<ol>
<li>每一个协议(<code>org.jetlinks.core.ProtocolSupport</code>) 对应有一个组件提供器对应 (<code>org.jetlinks.core.spi.ProtocolSupportProvider</code>)</li>
<li>自定义协议, 即实现 <code>org.jetlinks.core.spi.ProtocolSupportProvider</code> 这个接口;</li>
<li>统一由<code>org.jetlinks.supports.protocol.management.ProtocolSupportManager</code> 管理;</li>
<li>默认实现是<code>org.jetlinks.supports.protocol.management.ClusterProtocolSupportManager</code>(用Spring BeanPostProcessor hook自动加载 2.0是<code>org.jetlinks.community.protocol.configuration.ProtocolAutoConfiguration</code>配置类加载的)</li>
<li>调用其<code>org.jetlinks.supports.protocol.management.ClusterProtocolSupportManager#store</code>方法传递 ProtocolSupportDefinition 进行注册;</li>
</ol>
<p>注意: 注册后只存起来, 顾名思义, 还跟集群的其他节点有关, 而且跟协议的实现类型(jar,js)有关, 加载也不一样; 参考 <code>org.jetlinks.supports.protocol.management.ProtocolSupportDefinition</code>的属性</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class ProtocolSupportDefinition implements Serializable {
    private static final long serialVersionUID = -1;
    private String id;//ID ; 数据库存的就是本地对象的数据
    private String name;
    private String description;
    private String provider;//jar script 协议实现类型, 目前只有 jar, js 脚本
    private byte state;//协议状态
    private Map&lt;String,Object&gt; configuration;//配置元数据, jar 的话会存ProtocolSupportProvider类全限定名, jar包路径等
}
</code></pre>
<ol start="6">
<li>实例组件数据是存在数据库 <code>dev_protocol</code> 表</li>
</ol>
<p>参考下: [自定义协议开发]</p>
<h2 id="网关组件-orgjetlinkscommunitygatewaydevicegateway">网关组件 (org.jetlinks.community.gateway.DeviceGateway)</h2>
<p><strong>设备上报数据的处理逻辑入口,  网关代表接入方式需要选择网络组件,  它关联协议, 配置协议</strong></p>
<p><strong>负责平台侧统一的设备接入, 使用网络组件处理对应的请求以及报文, 使用配置的协议解析为平台统一的设备消息(DeviceMessage),然后推送到事件总线。</strong><br>
<code>org.jetlinks.community.gateway.supports.DeviceGateway</code> 网关接口抽象;<br>
设备网关支持提供商,用于提供对各种设备网关的支持.在启动设备网关时,会根据对应的提供商以及配置来创建设备网关. 实现统一管理网关配置,动态创建设备网关.</p>
<p>社区版, 网关的实现有三个</p>
<ul>
<li>在 <code>mqtt-component</code> 项目有两个</li>
</ul>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.mqtt.gateway.device.MqttClientDeviceGateway</code><br>
使用MQTT客户端, 连接第三方MQTT服务器; 例如 emqx</p>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.mqtt.gateway.device.MqttServerDeviceGateway</code><br>
本机作为MQTT服务端, 内置启用MQTT服务器, 接受设备接入;</p>
<ul>
<li>在 <code>tcp-component</code> 项目有一个</li>
</ul>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.tcp.device.TcpServerDeviceGateway</code><br>
本机作为TCP服务器, 监听端口, 接受设备接入;</p>
<p><strong>类似 桥接网络组件和协议组件(作为一个中介者)</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>统一由<code>org.jetlinks.community.gateway.DeviceGatewayManager</code>管理;</li>
<li>默认实现是 <code>org.jetlinks.community.gateway.supports.DefaultDeviceGatewayManager</code>(用Spring BeanPostProcessor hook自动加载; 2.0是<code>org.jetlinks.community.gateway.GatewayConfiguration</code>配置类加载的)</li>
<li>调用其<code>org.jetlinks.community.gateway.DeviceGatewayManager#start</code>传递一个网关实例ID 启动网关; 其实是改变了一下网关实例的状态, 在有新消息时根据自身状态决定是否分发消息, 在此之前已经调了协议解析, 所有暂停/停止网关不会影响协议跟设备的交互;<br>
参考: <code>org.jetlinks.community.network.mqtt.gateway.device.MqttClientDeviceGateway</code> 这个网关实现</li>
<li>实例组件是存在数据库 <code>device_gateway</code> 表</li>
</ol>
<h1 id="关键的对象概览">关键的对象概览</h1>
<h2 id="deviceregistry-设备注册中心">DeviceRegistry 设备注册中心</h2>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.core.device.DeviceRegistry</code></p>
<p>设备注册中心, 用于统一管理设备以及产品的基本信息,缓存,进行设备指令下发等操作.</p>
<p>例如: 获取设备以及设备的配置缓存信息</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">registry
    .getDevice(deviceId)
    .flatMap(device-&gt;device.getSelfConfig("my-config"))
    .flatMap(conf-&gt; doSomeThing(...))
</code></pre>
<p><strong>相当于总的设备管理器</strong></p>
<p>根据设备ID. 通过 <code>org.jetlinks.core.device.DeviceRegistry#getDevice </code> 可以获取设备操作对象(DeviceOperator)</p>
<p>以 <code>org.jetlinks.supports.cluster.ClusterDeviceRegistry#getDevice</code> 为例:</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt; getDevice(String deviceId) {
        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(deviceId)) {
            return Mono.empty();
        } else {
            //先从缓存获取
            Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt; deviceOperator = (Mono)this.operatorCache.getIfPresent(deviceId);
            if (null != deviceOperator) {
                return deviceOperator;
            } else {
                //创建 DeviceOperator
                DeviceOperator deviceOperator = this.createOperator(deviceId);
                return deviceOperator.getSelfConfig(DeviceConfigKey.productId).doOnNext((r) -&gt; {
                    //放到缓存
                    this.operatorCache.put(deviceId, Mono.just(deviceOperator).filterWhen((device) -&gt; {
                        return device.getSelfConfig(DeviceConfigKey.productId).hasElement();
                    }));
                }).map((ignore) -&gt; {
                    return deviceOperator;
                });
            }
        }
    }

    private DefaultDeviceOperator createOperator(String deviceId) {
        DefaultDeviceOperator device = new DefaultDeviceOperator(deviceId, this.supports, this.manager, this.handler, this, this.interceptor, this.stateChecker);
        if (this.rpcChain != null) {
            device.setRpcChain(this.rpcChain);
        }

        return device;
    }
</code></pre>
<h2 id="deviceoperator-设备操作接口">DeviceOperator 设备操作接口</h2>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.core.device.DeviceOperator</code><br>
设备操作接口,通过<code>DeviceRegister.getDevice(deviceId)</code>获取,用于对设备进行相关操作,如获取配置,发送消息等.</p>
<p>//通过getConfig 可以获取配置的协议元数据<br>
<code>DeviceOperator#getConfig</code></p>
<p>它是如何创建的?<br>
<code>org.jetlinks.core.defaults.DefaultDeviceOperator</code>为例<br>
从注册中心拿的时候, 如果不存在, 则创建DeviceOperator</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">  @Override
    public Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt; getDevice(String deviceId) {
        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(deviceId)) {
            return Mono.empty();
        }
        {

            Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt; deviceOperator = operatorCache.getIfPresent(deviceId);
            if (null != deviceOperator) {
                return deviceOperator;
            }
        }
        //创建  DeviceOperator
        DeviceOperator deviceOperator = createOperator(deviceId);
        return deviceOperator
                //有productId说明是存在的设备
                .getSelfConfig(DeviceConfigKey.productId)
                .doOnNext(r -&gt; operatorCache.put(deviceId, Mono
                        .just(deviceOperator)
                        .filterWhen(device -&gt; device.getSelfConfig(DeviceConfigKey.productId).hasElement())
                        //设备被注销了？则移除之
                        .switchIfEmpty(Mono.fromRunnable(() -&gt; operatorCache.invalidate(deviceId)))
                ))
                .map(ignore -&gt; deviceOperator);

    }
</code></pre>
<h2 id="deviceproductoperator-产品操作接口">DeviceProductOperator 产品操作接口</h2>
<p>DeviceProductOperator: 产品操作接口,通过DeviceProductOperator.getProduct(productId)获取.</p>
<h2 id="devicegateway-设备接入网关接口">DeviceGateway 设备接入网关接口</h2>
<p>DeviceGateway : 设备接入网关接口,利用网络组件来接入设备消息.</p>
<h2 id="devicemessagebusinesshandler">DeviceMessageBusinessHandler</h2>
<p>DeviceMessageBusinessHandler: 处理设备状态数据库同步,设备自动注册等逻辑等类.</p>
<h2 id="localdeviceinstanceservice">LocalDeviceInstanceService</h2>
<p>LocalDeviceInstanceService: 设备实例管理服务类.</p>
<h2 id="devicesessionmanager">DeviceSessionManager</h2>
<p>DeviceSessionManager: 设备会话管理器,可获取当前服务的会话信息.</p>
<p>管理会话, 设备的上线下线;</p>
<p>参考: <code>org.jetlinks.community.standalone.configuration.DefaultDeviceSessionManager</code><br>
在 <code>init</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">Flux.interval(Duration.ofSeconds(10), Duration.ofSeconds(30), Schedulers.newSingle("device-session-checker"))
    .flatMap(i -&gt; this
        .checkSession()//周期性 调用 checkSession() 检查状态
        .onErrorContinue((err, val) -&gt; log.error(err.getMessage(), err)))
    .subscribe();
</code></pre>
<h2 id="devicedatastoragepolicy-设备数据存储策略行式列式不存储">DeviceDataStoragePolicy 设备数据存储策略(行式/列式/不存储)</h2>
<p>DeviceDataStoragePolicy: 设备存储策略接口,实现此接口来进行自定义设备数据存储策略.</p>
<h2 id="devicegatewayhelper">DeviceGatewayHelper</h2>
<p>DeviceGatewayHelper: 统一处理设备消息,创建Session等操作的逻辑.</p>
<h2 id="decodedclientmessagehandler">DecodedClientMessageHandler</h2>
<p>DecodedClientMessageHandler: 解码后的平台消息处理器，如果是自定义实现网关或者在协议包里手动回复消息等处理, 则可以使用此接口直接将设备消息交给平台.(如果调用了DeviceGatewayHelper则不需要此操作).</p>
<h2 id="eventbus-事件总线">EventBus 事件总线</h2>
<p>EventBus: 事件总线,通过事件总线去订阅设备数据来实现解耦.(也可以用过@Subscribe()注解订阅).</p>
<h2 id="devicemessageconnector">DeviceMessageConnector</h2>
<p>DeviceMessageConnector: 负责将设备消息转发到事件总线.</p>
<h2 id="devicemessagesender-消息发送器">DeviceMessageSender 消息发送器</h2>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.core.device.DeviceMessageSender</code><br>
消息发送器,用于发送消息给设备.</p>
<h2 id="devicemessage-消息对象">DeviceMessage 消息对象</h2>
<p>所有设备消息(即设备上报转换后, 平台可识别的消息) 派生自这个 <code>org.jetlinks.core.message.DeviceMessage</code> 接口</p>
<h2 id="encodedmessage-消息对象">EncodedMessage 消息对象</h2>
<p>设备端原始的消息, (下发/上报给的原始消息)</p>
<h1 id="源码大体流程研究">源码大体流程研究</h1>
<h2 id="先了解消息的组成">先了解消息的组成</h2>
<p>消息主要由 <code>deviceId</code>, <code>messageId</code>, <code>headers</code>, <code>timestamp</code> 组成.</p>
<p>deviceId为设备的唯一标识, messageId为消息的唯一标识,headers为消息头,通常用于对自定义消息处理的行为,如是否异步消息, 是否分片消息等.</p>
<p>常用的Headers <code>org.jetlinks.core.message.Headers</code><br>
<code>async</code> 是否异步,boolean类型.<br>
<code>timeout</code> 指定超时时间. 毫秒.<br>
<code>frag_msg_id</code> 分片主消息ID,为下发消息的messageId<br>
<code>frag_num</code> 分片总数<br>
<code>frag_part</code> 当前分片索引<br>
<code>frag_last</code> 是否为最后一个分片,当无法确定分片数量的时候,可以将分片设置到足够大,最后一个分片设置:frag_last=true来完成返回.<br>
<code>keepOnline</code> 与DeviceOnlineMessage配合使用,在TCP短链接,保持设备一直在线状态,连接断开不会设置设备离线.<br>
<code>keepOnlineTimeoutSeconds</code> 指定在线超时时间,在短链接时,如果超过此间隔没有收到消息则认为设备离线.<br>
<code>ignoreStorage</code> 不存储此消息数据,如: 读写属性回复默认也会记录到属性时序数据库中,设置为true后,将不记录.(1.9版本后支持)<br>
<code>ignoreLog</code> 不记录此消息到日志,如: 设置为true,将不记录此消息的日志.<br>
<code>mergeLatest</code> 是否合并最新属性数据,设置此消息头后,将会把最新的消息合并到消息体里( 需要开启最新数据存储)//jetlinks.device.storage.enable-last-data-in-db=true 是否将设备最新到数据存储到数据库</p>
<p>网络组件(Network) 真正与设备连接交互的网络层, 但是它只负责接收/发送报文,不负责任何处理逻辑, 所以最佳的调试地方是网关组件(DeviceGateway)入口处.</p>
<h3 id="消息类型">消息类型</h3>
<p><strong>所有消息类型参考</strong> <code>org.jetlinks.community.device.enums.DeviceLogType</code></p>
<h4 id="属性相关消息">属性相关消息</h4>
<p>获取设备属性(<code>ReadPropertyMessage</code>)对应设备回复的消息 <code>ReadPropertyMessageReply</code>.<br>
修改设备属性(<code>WritePropertyMessage</code>)对应设备回复的消息 <code>WritePropertyMessageReply</code>.<br>
设备上报属性(<code>ReportPropertyMessage</code>) 由设备上报.</p>
<h4 id="功能相关消息">功能相关消息</h4>
<p>调用设备功能到消息(<code>FunctionInvokeMessage</code>)由平台发往设备,对应到返回消息 <code>FunctionInvokeMessageReply</code>.</p>
<h4 id="事件消息">事件消息</h4>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.core.message.event.EventMessage</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">EventMessage eventMessage = new EventMessage();
eventMessage.setDeviceId(deviceId);
eventMessage.setMessageId(fromDevice.path(MessageConstant.MESSAGE_KEY_MESSAGE_SIGN).asText() );
eventMessage.event(eventId);

HashMap data = JacksonUtils.jsonToBean(output.toString(), HashMap.class);
eventMessage.setData(data);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="其他消息">其他消息</h4>
<p><code>DeviceOnlineMessage</code> 设备上线消息,通常用于网关代理的子设备的上线操作.<br>
<code>DeviceOfflineMessage</code> 设备离线消息,通常用于网关代理的子设备的下线操作.<br>
<code>ChildDeviceMessage</code> 子设备消息,通常用于网关代理的子设备的消息.<br>
<code>ChildDeviceMessageReply</code> 子设备消息回复,用于平台向网关代理的子设备发送消息后设备回复给平台的结果.<br>
<code>UpdateTagMessage</code> 更新设备标签.<br>
<code>DerivedMetadataMessage</code> 更新设备独立物模型.</p>
<h4 id="设备自注册消息">设备自注册消息</h4>
<p><code>DeviceRegisterMessage</code> 设备注册消息,通过设置消息头<code>message.addHeader("deviceName","设备名称");</code>和 <code>message.addHeader("productId","产品ID")</code>可实现设备自动注册.<br>
如果配置了状态自管理,在检查子设备状态时,会发送指令<code>ChildDeviceMessage&lt;DeviceStateCheckMessage&gt;</code>, 网关需要返回<code>ChildDeviceMessageReply&lt;DeviceStateCheckMessageReply&gt;</code>.</p>
<p>自定义协议包将消息解析为 <code>DeviceRegisterMessage</code>,<br>
并设置header:productId(必选),deviceName(必选),configuration(可选)。<br>
平台将自动添加设备信息到设备实例中。如果是注册子设备,则解析为 <code>ChildDeviceMessage&lt;DeviceRegisterMessage&gt;</code>即可</p>
<h2 id="消息上报-mqtt-broker">消息上报 (MQTT Broker)</h2>
<p>设备不是直接接入平台, 而是通过第三方MQTT服务, 如:emqx. 消息编解码与MQTT服务一样,从消息协议中使用 DefaultTransport.MQTT 来获取消息编解码器.</p>
<h3 id="网关处理逻辑">网关处理逻辑</h3>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.mqtt.gateway.device.MqttClientDeviceGateway</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class MqttClientDeviceGateway extends AbstractDeviceGateway {
public MqttClientDeviceGateway(String id,
                                MqttClient mqttClient,
                                DeviceRegistry registry,
                                ProtocolSupports protocolSupport,
                                String protocol,
                                DeviceSessionManager sessionManager,
                                DecodedClientMessageHandler clientMessageHandler,
                                List&lt;String&gt; topics,
                                int qos) {
    super(id);
    // mqtt的客户端
    this.mqttClient = Objects.requireNonNull(mqttClient, "mqttClient");
    //DeviceRegistry : 设备注册中心,  用于统一管理设备以及产品的基本信息,缓存,进行设备指令下发等操作(约等于设备统一管理器)
    this.registry = Objects.requireNonNull(registry, "registry");
    this.protocolSupport = Objects.requireNonNull(protocolSupport, "protocolSupport");
    this.protocol = Objects.requireNonNull(protocol, "protocol");
    this.topics = Objects.requireNonNull(topics, "topics");
    this.helper = new DeviceGatewayHelper(registry, sessionManager, clientMessageHandler);
    this.qos = qos;
}

private void doStart() {
    if (disposable != null) {
        disposable.dispose();
    }
    disposable = mqttClient
        .subscribe(topics, qos)//关注MQTT主题, 当有新的消息时
        .filter((msg) -&gt; isStarted())//需当前网关 处于启动状态
        .flatMap(mqttMessage -&gt; {
            AtomicReference&lt;Duration&gt; timeoutRef = new AtomicReference&lt;&gt;();
            return this
                //注意这里是根据自定义协议 ProtocolSupportProvider::create 返回的 ProtocolSupport id 去匹配的
                .getProtocol()
                //通过 ProtocolSupport 获取其 DeviceMessageCodec
                .flatMap(codec -&gt; codec.getMessageCodec(getTransport()))
                //使用消息编码器 解码消息
                .flatMapMany(codec -&gt; codec.decode(FromDeviceMessageContext.of(
                    new UnknownDeviceMqttClientSession(getId() + ":unknown", mqttClient) {//实际给到协议编解码器的Session 总是这个..
                        @Override
                        public Mono&lt;Boolean&gt; send(EncodedMessage encodedMessage) {
                            return super
                                .send(encodedMessage)
                                .doOnSuccess(r -&gt; monitor.sentMessage());
                        }
                        @Override
                        public void setKeepAliveTimeout(Duration timeout) {
                            timeoutRef.set(timeout);
                        }
                    }
                    , mqttMessage, registry)
                ))
                .doOnError((err) -&gt; log.error("解码MQTT客户端消息失败 {}:{}",       //发生了错误
                                                mqttMessage.getTopic(),
                                                mqttMessage
                                                    .getPayload()
                                                    .toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                                                err))
                //消息向上转型
                .cast(DeviceMessage.class)
                .flatMap(message -&gt; {
                    //设备网关监控 (主要是监控消息数量等指标的)
                    monitor.receivedMessage();
                    return helper//设备网关消息处理,会话管理工具类,用于统一封装对设备消息和会话的处理逻辑
                        .handleDeviceMessage(message,//最终主要源码见下:  org.jetlinks.community.network.utils.DeviceGatewayHelper#handleDeviceMessage
                                                device -&gt; createDeviceSession(device, mqttClient),//&lt;!&gt; 注意这个会话在不存在时回调; 见下: [创建会话的回调]
                                                ignore-&gt;{},//会话自定义回调,处理会话时用来自定义会话,比如重置连接信
                                                () -&gt; log.warn("无法从MQTT[{}]消息中获取设备信息:{}", mqttMessage.print(), message)//当设备在平台不存在时
                        );
                })
                .then()
                //错误处理, 返回 empty
                .onErrorResume((err) -&gt; {
                    log.error("处理MQTT消息失败:{}", mqttMessage, err);
                    return Mono.empty();
                });
        }, Integer.MAX_VALUE)
        .onErrorContinue((err, ms) -&gt; log.error("处理MQTT客户端消息失败", err))
        .subscribe();//Flux的API  触发计算
}

}

</code></pre>

<p>//如果设备状态为'离线' 则会先构造一个设备上线的消息 publish, 然后在 publish 设备原消息<br>
<code> org.jetlinks.community.network.utils.DeviceGatewayHelper#handleDeviceMessage</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> public Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt; handleDeviceMessage(DeviceMessage message,
                                                Function&lt;DeviceOperator, Mono&lt;DeviceSession&gt;&gt; sessionBuilder,  //会话构造器,在会话不存在时,创建会话
                                                Function&lt;DeviceSession, Mono&lt;Void&gt;&gt; sessionConsumer,//会话自定义回调, 见上
                                                Supplier&lt;Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt;&gt; deviceNotFoundCallback//设备不存在的监听器回调
                                                ) {
    String deviceId = message.getDeviceId();
    if (!StringUtils.hasText(deviceId)) {
        return Mono.empty();
    }
    Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt; then = null;
    boolean doHandle = true;
    // ........
    // 忽略.. 子设备消息,子设备消息回复, 设备离线消息, 设备上线,  平台处理的消息流程分支
    // ........
    
    if (then == null) {
        then = registry.getDevice(deviceId);
    }
    if (doHandle) {
        //&lt;!&gt; 真正主要处理消息部分!  从 设备注册中心 拿到 DeviceOperator 然后在 org.jetlinks.community.device.message.DeviceMessageConnector#handleMessage 处理
        //&lt;!&gt; 见下 [发布消息总线]
        then = then.flatMap(opt -&gt; messageHandler.handleMessage(opt, message).thenReturn(opt));
    }


    return this
        // 创建或者更新 Session  
        //&lt;!&gt; 见下[会话的创建]
        .createOrUpdateSession(deviceId, message, sessionBuilder, deviceNotFoundCallback) 
        .flatMap(sessionConsumer)
        .then(then)//不在意流元素, 在流结束后返回 'then' (即: Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt; then 上面定义的)
        .contextWrite(Context.of(DeviceMessage.class, message));//往 context 中写入 DeviceMessage; key是DeviceMessage.class; (Context 类似Map其内部用于传递数据, 注意contextWrite读取值时, 下游优先;从下往上)
}

<h4 id="会话的创建逻辑">会话的创建逻辑</h4>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.utils.DeviceGatewayHelper#createOrUpdateSession</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> private Mono&lt;DeviceSession&gt; createOrUpdateSession(String deviceId,
                                                      DeviceMessage message,
                                                      Function&lt;DeviceOperator, Mono&lt;DeviceSession&gt;&gt; sessionBuilder,
                                                      Supplier&lt;Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt;&gt; deviceNotFoundCallback) {
        return sessionManager
            .getSession(deviceId, false)
            .filterWhen(DeviceSession::isAliveAsync)
            .map(old -&gt; {
                //需要更新会话时才进行更新
                if (needUpdateSession(old, message)) {
                    return sessionManager
                        .compute(deviceId, null, session -&gt; updateSession(session, message, sessionBuilder));
                }
                applySessionKeepaliveTimeout(message, old);
                old.keepAlive();
                return Mono.just(old);
            })
            //会话不存在 则尝试创建或者更新
            .defaultIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -&gt; sessionManager //&lt;!&gt; 注意 注意 注意 这个会话管理 `sessionManager.compute` 见下 [设备会话注册 (上线事件)]
                .compute(deviceId,
                         createNewSession(//&lt;!&gt; 见下 &lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;创建会话&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;
                             deviceId,
                             message,
                             sessionBuilder,
                             () -&gt; {// deviceNotFoundCallback 回调
                                 //设备注册
                                 if (isDoRegister(message)) {
                                     return messageHandler
                                         .handleMessage(null, message)
                                         //延迟2秒后尝试重新获取设备并上线
                                         .then(Mono.delay(Duration.ofSeconds(2)))
                                         .then(registry.getDevice(deviceId));
                                 }
                                 if (deviceNotFoundCallback != null) {
                                     return deviceNotFoundCallback.get();
                                 }
                                 return Mono.empty();
                             }),
                        //compute 的第二个参数
                         session -&gt; updateSession(session, message, sessionBuilder))))
            .flatMap(Function.identity());
    }
    //org.jetlinks.community.network.utils.DeviceGatewayHelper#createNewSession
    //&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;创建会话&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;
    private Mono&lt;DeviceSession&gt; createNewSession(String deviceId,
                                                 DeviceMessage message,
                                                 Function&lt;DeviceOperator, Mono&lt;DeviceSession&gt;&gt; sessionBuilder,
                                                 Supplier&lt;Mono&lt;DeviceOperator&gt;&gt; deviceNotFoundCallback) {
        return registry
            .getDevice(deviceId)//从注册中心 拿 DeviceOperator
            .switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(deviceNotFoundCallback))
            .flatMap(device -&gt; sessionBuilder //给设备 回调 SessionBuilder 创建会话  见上: [创建会话的回调]
                .apply(device)
                .map(newSession -&gt; {
                    //保持在线，在低功率设备上,可能无法保持长连接,通过keepOnline的header来标识让设备保持在线
                    if (message.getHeader(Headers.keepOnline).orElse(false)) {
                        int timeout = message.getHeaderOrDefault(Headers.keepOnlineTimeoutSeconds);
                        newSession = new KeepOnlineSession(newSession, Duration.ofSeconds(timeout));
                    }
                    return newSession;
                }));
    }
</code></pre>

                                .flatMap(this::doRegister)//创建完成, 注册会话 见下
                                .doOnNext(this::replaceSession);
                    } else {
    ... 省略 ...

<p><code>org.jetlinks.supports.device.session.AbstractDeviceSessionManager#doRegister</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">  private Mono&lt;DeviceSession&gt; doRegister(DeviceSession session) {
        if (session.getOperator() == null) {
            return Mono.empty();
        }
        return this
                .remoteSessionIsAlive(session.getDeviceId())
                .flatMap(alive -&gt; session
                        .getOperator()//调 DeviceOperator 的 online
                        .online(getCurrentServerId(), session.getId(), session
                                .getClientAddress()
                                .map(InetSocketAddress::toString)
                                .orElse(null))
                        .then(fireEvent(DeviceSessionEvent.of(DeviceSessionEvent.Type.register, session, alive))))//触发事件 见下
                .thenReturn(session);
    }
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-java"> protected Mono&lt;Void&gt; fireEvent(DeviceSessionEvent event) {
        if (sessionEventHandlers.isEmpty()) {
            return Mono.empty();
        }
        return Flux
                .fromIterable(sessionEventHandlers)
                .flatMap(handler -&gt; Mono
                        .defer(() -&gt; handler.apply(event))
                        .onErrorResume(err -&gt; {
                            log.error("fire session event error {}", event, err);
                            return Mono.empty();
                        }))
                .then();
    }

</code></pre>
<p>典型的观察者模式,  那么是谁订阅了, 在哪里处理这个事件?</p>
<h5 id="上线离线-事件总线发布">上线/离线 事件总线发布</h5>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.device.message.DeviceMessageConnector#DeviceMessageConnector</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">  public DeviceMessageConnector(EventBus eventBus,
                                  DeviceRegistry registry,
                                  MessageHandler messageHandler,
                                  DeviceSessionManager sessionManager) {
        this.registry = registry;
        this.eventBus = eventBus;
        this.messageHandler = messageHandler;
        sessionManager.listenEvent(event-&gt;{// sessionManager 即是 AbstractDeviceSessionManager 的派生类; 订阅上线/离线事件
            if(event.isClusterExists()){
                return Mono.empty();
            }
            //从会话管理器里监听会话注册,转发为设备离线消息
            if(event.getType()== DeviceSessionEvent.Type.unregister){
                return this.handleSessionUnregister(event.getSession());
            }
            //从会话管理器里监听会话注销,转发为设备上线消息
            if(event.getType()== DeviceSessionEvent.Type.register){
                return this.handleSessionRegister(event.getSession());//见下
            }
            return Mono.empty();
        });
    }
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-java"> protected Mono&lt;Void&gt; handleSessionRegister(DeviceSession session) {
        DeviceOnlineMessage message = new DeviceOnlineMessage();
        message.addHeader("from", "session-register");
        //添加客户端地址信息
        message.addHeader("address", session.getClientAddress().map(InetSocketAddress::toString).orElse(""));
        message.setDeviceId(session.getDeviceId());
        message.setTimestamp(System.currentTimeMillis());
        // 最终殊途同归 调到 org.jetlinks.community.device.message.DeviceMessageConnector#onMessage 发布事件总线
        return this
            .onMessage(message)
            .onErrorResume(doOnError);
    }
</code></pre>
<h5 id="同步设备状态到数据库">同步设备状态到数据库</h5>
<p>在 <code>org.jetlinks.community.device.service.DeviceMessageBusinessHandler#init</code> 方法<br>
使用代码订阅消息事件总线, 设备上下线消息...</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostConstruct
public void init() {

        Subscription subscription = Subscription
            .builder()
            .subscriberId("device-state-synchronizer")
            .topics("/device/*/*/online", "/device/*/*/offline")
            .justLocal()//只订阅本地
            .build();

        //订阅设备上下线消息,同步数据库中的设备状态,
        //最小间隔800毫秒,最大缓冲数量500,最长间隔2秒.
        //如果2条消息间隔大于0.8秒则不缓冲直接更新
        //否则缓冲,数量超过500后批量更新
        //无论缓冲区是否超过500条,都每2秒更新一次.
        FluxUtils.bufferRate(eventBus
                                 .subscribe(subscription, DeviceMessage.class)
                                 .map(DeviceMessage::getDeviceId),
                             800, Integer.getInteger("device.state.sync.batch", 500), Duration.ofSeconds(2))
                 .onBackpressureBuffer(64,
                                       list -&gt; log.warn("无法处理更多设备状态同步!"),
                                       BufferOverflowStrategy.DROP_OLDEST)
                 .publishOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic(), 64)
                 .concatMap(list -&gt; deviceService.syncStateBatch(Flux.just(list), false).map(List::size))
                 .onErrorContinue((err, obj) -&gt; log.error(err.getMessage(), err))
                 .subscribe((i) -&gt; log.info("同步设备状态成功:{}", i));

    }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="发布消息总线">发布消息总线</h3>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.device.message.DeviceMessageConnector#handleMessage</code><br>
<code>org.jetlinks.community.device.message.DeviceMessageConnector#onMessage</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> public Mono&lt;Void&gt; onMessage(Message message) {
    if (null == message) {
        return Mono.empty();
    }
    message.addHeader(PropertyConstants.uid, IDGenerator.SNOW_FLAKE_STRING.generate());
    return this
        //处理子设备消息 和 &lt;&gt;盲猜提取事件总线的匹配路径 @Subscribe("/device/*/*/online") 
        .getTopic(message)
        //事件总线发布, //基于订阅发布的事件总线,可用于事件传递,消息转发等.
        //见下[消息总线发布过程]
        .flatMap(topic -&gt; eventBus.publish(topic, message).then())
        .onErrorResume(doOnError)//发生错误 返回一个  Mono.empty();
        .then();
}

</code></pre>
<h4 id="消息总线发布过程">消息总线发布过程</h4>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.core.event.EventBus#publish(java.lang.String, org.jetlinks.core.Payload)</code><br>
<code>org.jetlinks.supports.event.BrokerEventBus#publish(java.lang.String, org.jetlinks.core.codec.Encoder&lt;T&gt;, T)</code><br>
<code>org.jetlinks.supports.event.BrokerEventBus#publish(java.lang.String, org.jetlinks.core.codec.Encoder&lt;T&gt;, T, reactor.core.scheduler.Scheduler)</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">   @Override
    public &lt;T&gt; Mono&lt;Long&gt; publish(String topic, Encoder&lt;T&gt; encoder, T payload, Scheduler scheduler) {
        return TraceHolder
                //写入跟踪信息到header中
                .writeContextTo(TopicPayload.of(topic, Payload.of(payload, encoder)), TopicPayload::addHeader)
                .map(pld -&gt; {
                    long subs = this
                            //见下[过滤/处理共享订阅]
                            .doPublish(pld.getTopic(),
                                       sub -&gt; !sub.isLocal() || sub.hasFeature(Subscription.Feature.local),
                                       //见下: 生成推送
                                       sub -&gt; doPublish(pld.getTopic(), sub, pld)
                            );
                    if (log.isTraceEnabled()) {
                        log.trace("topic [{}] has {} subscriber", pld.getTopic(), subs);
                    }
                    ReferenceCountUtil.safeRelease(pld);
                    return subs;
                });
    }
</code></pre>
<p><strong>过滤/处理共享订阅</strong><br>
<code>org.jetlinks.supports.event.BrokerEventBus#doPublish(java.lang.String, java.util.function.Predicate&lt;org.jetlinks.supports.event.BrokerEventBus.SubscriptionInfo&gt;, java.util.function.Consumer&lt;org.jetlinks.supports.event.BrokerEventBus.SubscriptionInfo&gt;)</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">private long doPublish(String topic,
                        Predicate&lt;SubscriptionInfo&gt; predicate,
                        Consumer&lt;SubscriptionInfo&gt; subscriberConsumer) {
    //共享订阅, (有多个订阅者)只有一个订阅者能收到 
    Map&lt;String, List&lt;SubscriptionInfo&gt;&gt; sharedMap = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
    //去重
    Set&lt;Object&gt; distinct = new HashSet&lt;&gt;(64);
    //从订阅表中查找topic
    root.findTopic(topic, subs -&gt; {
        for (SubscriptionInfo sub : subs.getSubscribers()) {
            //broker已经失效则不推送
            if (sub.isBroker() &amp;&amp; !sub.getEventConnection().isAlive()) {
                sub.dispose();
                continue;
            }
            if (!predicate.test(sub) || !distinct.add(sub.sink)) {
                continue;
            }
            //共享订阅时,添加到缓存,最后再处理
            if (sub.hasFeature(Subscription.Feature.shared)) {
                sharedMap
                        .computeIfAbsent(sub.subscriber, ignore -&gt; new ArrayList&lt;&gt;(8))
                        .add(sub);
                continue;
            }
            subscriberConsumer.accept(sub);
        }
    }, () -&gt; {
        //处理共享订阅
        for (List&lt;SubscriptionInfo&gt; value : sharedMap.values()) {
            subscriberConsumer.accept(value.get(ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, value.size())));
        }
    });
    return distinct.size();
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>生成推送</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">private boolean doPublish(String topic, SubscriptionInfo info, TopicPayload payload) {
        try {
            //已经取消订阅则不推送
            if (info.sink.isCancelled()) {
                return false;
            }
            payload.retain();
            info.sink.next(payload);
            if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {
                log.debug("publish [{}] to [{}] complete", topic, info);
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable error) {
            log.error("publish [{}] to [{}] event error", topic, info, error);
            ReferenceCountUtil.safeRelease(payload);
        }
        return false;
    }
</code></pre>
<h4 id="关于消息总线">关于消息总线</h4>
<p><a href="http://doc.jetlinks.cn/dev-guide/event-driver.html#eventbus" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">关于事件总线和消息总线</a></p>
<p><code>@Subscribe("/device/**")</code></p>
<p>采用树结构来定义topic如:/device/id/message/type . topic支持路径通配符,如:/device/** 或者/device/<em>/message/</em>.</p>
<h4 id="设备消息主题">设备消息主题</h4>
<p>也可参考 <code>org.jetlinks.pro.utils.TopicUtils</code><br>
消息的topic 的前缀均为: /device/{productId}/{deviceId}.</p>
<p>如:产品product-1下的设备device-1上线消息: <code>/device/product-1/device-1/online</code>.<br>
可通过通配符订阅所有设备的指定消息,如:/device/<em>/</em>/online,或者订阅所有消息:/device/**.</p>

<pre><code class="language-java">/**
* 保存单个设备消息,为了提升性能,存储策略会对保存请求进行缓冲,达到一定条件后
* 再进行批量写出,具体由不同对存储策略实现。

* @return void

@Nonnull
@Override
public Mono&lt;Void&gt; saveDeviceMessage(@Nonnull DeviceMessage message) {
    return this
        .getDeviceStrategy(message.getDeviceId())
        .flatMap(strategy -&gt; strategy.saveDeviceMessage(message));
}

<pre><code class="language-java">@SneakyThrows
public Flux&lt;?&gt; invokeFunction(String deviceId,
                                String functionId,
                                Map&lt;String, Object&gt; properties) {
    return registry
        .getDevice(deviceId)//通过 设备注册中心 找 DeviceOperator
        .switchIfEmpty(ErrorUtils.notFound("设备不存在"))
        .flatMap(operator -&gt; operator
            .messageSender()//拿到 消息发送器, 用于发送消息给设备. 
            .invokeFunction(functionId)//new 了一个消息对象; new DefaultFunctionInvokeMessageSender(operator, function); 
            .messageId(IDGenerator.SNOW_FLAKE_STRING.generate())//生成唯一消息id
            .setParameter(properties)//设置入参 org.jetlinks.core.defaults.DefaultFunctionInvokeMessageSender#setParameter
            .validate()//验证入参 org.jetlinks.core.defaults.DefaultFunctionInvokeMessageSender#validate
        )
        .flatMapMany(FunctionInvokeMessageSender::send)//调用发送  org.jetlinks.core.defaults.DefaultFunctionInvokeMessageSender#send 见下:
        .flatMap(mapReply(FunctionInvokeMessageReply::getOutput));//处理回复
}

<h3 id="核心逻辑">核心逻辑</h3>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.core.defaults.DefaultDeviceMessageSender#send(org.reactivestreams.Publisher&lt;org.jetlinks.core.message.RepayableDeviceMessage&lt;R&gt;&gt;)</code><br>
<code>org.jetlinks.core.defaults.DefaultDeviceMessageSender#send(org.reactivestreams.Publisher&lt;? extends org.jetlinks.core.message.DeviceMessage&gt;, java.util.function.Function&lt;java.lang.Object,R&gt;)</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">/**
    * 发送消息并自定义返回结果转换器
    *
    * @param message      消息
    * @param replyMapping 消息回复转换器
    * @param &lt;R&gt;          回复类型
    * @return 异步发送结果
    * @see DeviceMessageSender#send(Publisher)
    */
public &lt;R extends DeviceMessage&gt; Flux&lt;R&gt; send(Publisher&lt;? extends DeviceMessage&gt; message, Function&lt;Object, R&gt; replyMapping) {
    return Mono
            .zip(
                    //当前设备连接的服务器ID
                    operator.getConnectionServerId()
                            .switchIfEmpty(refreshAndGetConnectionServerId())
                            .defaultIfEmpty(""),
                    //拦截器
                    operator.getProtocol()
                            .flatMap(ProtocolSupport::getSenderInterceptor)
                            .defaultIfEmpty(DeviceMessageSenderInterceptor.DO_NOTING),//如果没有, 返回一个啥也不干的 消息拦截处理器 org.jetlinks.core.message.interceptor.DeviceMessageSenderInterceptor
                    //网关id
                    operator.getSelfConfig(DeviceConfigKey.parentGatewayId).defaultIfEmpty("")
            )//合并: 这里 T1是 服务器ID, T2是 消息拦截器, T3是 父设备的网关ID
            .flatMapMany(serverAndInterceptor -&gt; {
                DeviceMessageSenderInterceptor interceptor = serverAndInterceptor
                        .getT2()
                        .andThen(globalInterceptor);
                String server = serverAndInterceptor.getT1();
                String parentGatewayId = serverAndInterceptor.getT3();
                //有上级网关设备则通过父级设备发送消息
                if (StringUtils.isEmpty(server) &amp;&amp; StringUtils.hasText(parentGatewayId)) {
                    return Flux
                            .from(message)
                            .flatMap(msg -&gt; interceptor.preSend(operator, msg))
                            .flatMap(msg -&gt; this
                                    .sendToParentDevice(parentGatewayId, msg)
                                    .as(flux -&gt; interceptor.afterSent(operator, msg, interceptor.doSend(operator, msg, flux)))
                            )
                            .map(r -&gt; (R) r);
                }
                return Flux
                    .from(message)
                    .flatMap(msg -&gt; interceptor.preSend(operator,msg))//hook 预回调; 在消息发送前触发. 执行此方法后将使用返回值DeviceMessage进行发送到设备.
                    .concatMap(msg -&gt; Flux
                            .defer(() -&gt; {
                                //缓存中没有serverId,说明当前设备并未连接到平台.
                                if (StringUtils.isEmpty(server)) {
                                    return interceptor.afterSent(operator, msg, Flux.error(new DeviceOperationException(ErrorCode.CLIENT_OFFLINE)));
                                }
                                boolean forget = msg.getHeader(Headers.sendAndForget).orElse(false);
                                //(预定义,回复的处理) 定义处理来自设备的回复.
                                Flux&lt;R&gt; replyStream = forget
                                        ? Flux.empty()
                                        : handler //监听来自其他服务的回复 (集群代理) org.jetlinks.core.device.DeviceOperationBroker
                                        .handleReply(msg.getDeviceId(),
                                                        msg.getMessageId(),
                                                        Duration.ofMillis(msg.getHeader(Headers.timeout)
                                                                            .orElse(defaultTimeout)))//这里处理等待回复的 超时时间&lt;!&gt;
                                        .map(replyMapping)//处理回复; 参见: org.jetlinks.core.defaults.DefaultDeviceMessageSender#convertReply(java.lang.Object) ; 其实是处理 DeviceMessageReply 实例的消息
                                        .onErrorResume(DeviceOperationException.class, error -&gt; {
                                            if (error.getCode() == ErrorCode.CLIENT_OFFLINE) {
                                                //返回离线错误,重新检查状态,以矫正设备缓存的状态
                                                return operator
                                                        .checkState()
                                                        .then(Mono.error(error));
                                            }
                                            return Mono.error(error);
                                        })
                                        .onErrorMap(TimeoutException.class, timeout -&gt; new DeviceOperationException(ErrorCode.TIME_OUT, timeout))
                                        .as(flux -&gt; this.logReply(msg, flux));

                                //发送消息到设备连接的服务器
                                return handler// (集群代理) org.jetlinks.core.device.DeviceOperationBroker
                                        .send(server, Mono.just(msg))// =========== &lt;!&gt; 见下: 集群的处理
                                        .defaultIfEmpty(-1)
                                        .flatMapMany(len -&gt; {
                                            //设备未连接到服务器
                                            if (len == 0) {
                                                //尝试发起状态检查,同步设备的真实状态
                                                return operator
                                                        .checkState()
                                                        .flatMapMany(state -&gt; {
                                                            if (DeviceState.online != state) {
                                                                return interceptor.afterSent(operator, msg, Flux.error(new DeviceOperationException(ErrorCode.CLIENT_OFFLINE)));
                                                            }
                                                /*
                                                    设备在线,但是serverId对应的服务没有监听处理消息
                                                        1. 服务挂了
                                                        2. 设备缓存的serverId不对
                                                    */
                                                            //尝试发送给父设备
                                                            if (StringUtils.hasText(parentGatewayId)) {
                                                                log.debug("Device [{}] Cached Server [{}] Not Available,Dispatch To Parent [{}]",
                                                                            operator.getDeviceId(),
                                                                            server,
                                                                            parentGatewayId);

                                                                return interceptor
                                                                        .afterSent(operator, msg, sendToParentDevice(parentGatewayId, msg))
                                                                        .map(r -&gt; (R) r);
                                                            }
                                                            log.warn("Device [{}] Cached Server [{}] Not Available",
                                                                        operator.getDeviceId(),
                                                                        server);

                                                            return interceptor.afterSent(operator, msg, Flux.error(new DeviceOperationException(ErrorCode.SERVER_NOT_AVAILABLE)));
                                                        });
                                            } else if (len == -1) {
                                                return interceptor.afterSent(operator, msg, Flux.error(new DeviceOperationException(ErrorCode.CLIENT_OFFLINE)));
                                            }
                                            log.debug("send device[{}] message complete", operator.getDeviceId());
                                            return interceptor.afterSent(operator, msg, replyStream);
                                        })
                                        ;
                            })
                            .as(flux -&gt; interceptor
                                    .doSend(operator, msg, flux.cast(DeviceMessage.class))
                                    .map(_resp -&gt; (R) _resp)));
        });

}
</code></pre>

        Member member = getMember(deviceGatewayServerId);

<h3 id="消息队列--计数">消息队列 &amp; 计数</h3>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.supports.cluster.ClusterDeviceOperationBroker#handleSendToDevice</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">private Mono&lt;Void&gt; handleSendToDevice(Message message) {
    if(message instanceof RepayableDeviceMessage){//如果是 有回复的消息 放到队列
        RepayableDeviceMessage&lt;?&gt; msg = ((RepayableDeviceMessage&lt;?&gt;) message);
        awaits.put(getAwaitReplyKey(msg),msg);
    }
    if (sendToDevice.currentSubscriberCount() == 0//判断 sendToDevice 有无订阅者
            // `sendToDevice` 这个对象, 是 Reactor 体系的, 类似消息队列之类的; 
            // tryEmitNext 提交会被其订阅者消费; 异步提交, 返回提交成功/失败的状态;
            // 1. 在哪被订阅的? 见下 handleSendToDeviceMessage 方法内 `sendToDevice.asFlux()`, 它的返回是可以被订阅的 '序列流'
            // 2. 在什么时候被订阅的? 见下: [下发消息处理的订阅]
            //  
            || sendToDevice.tryEmitNext(message).isFailure()) {
        log.warn("no handler for message {}", message);
        // 处理消息回复 ======================= &lt;!&gt; 见下: [回复处理]
        return doReply(createReply(message).error(ErrorCode.SYSTEM_ERROR));
    }
    return Mono.empty();
}
@Override
public Flux&lt;Message&gt; handleSendToDeviceMessage(String serverId) {
    return sendToDevice.asFlux();
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="下发消息处理的订阅">下发消息处理的订阅</h3>
<p>Spring 的入口配置类, 创建 <code>ClusterSendToDeviceMessageHandler</code><br>
<code>org.jetlinks.community.configure.device.DeviceClusterConfiguration</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@ConditionalOnBean(DecodedClientMessageHandler.class)
@Bean
public ClusterSendToDeviceMessageHandler defaultSendToDeviceMessageHandler(
        DeviceSessionManager sessionManager,
        DeviceRegistry registry,
        MessageHandler messageHandler,//注意这个 messageHandler 就是 ClusterDeviceOperationBroker
        DecodedClientMessageHandler clientMessageHandler) {
    return new ClusterSendToDeviceMessageHandler(sessionManager, messageHandler, registry, clientMessageHandler);
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.supports.server.ClusterSendToDeviceMessageHandler#init</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> public ClusterSendToDeviceMessageHandler(
        DeviceSessionManager sessionManager,
        MessageHandler handler,
        DeviceRegistry registry,
        DecodedClientMessageHandler decodedClientMessageHandler) {
        
    this.sessionManager = sessionManager;
    this.handler = handler;
    this.registry = registry;
    this.decodedClientMessageHandler = decodedClientMessageHandler;
    init();
}
private void init() {
    handler
            .handleSendToDeviceMessage(sessionManager.getCurrentServerId())//这里调用 ClusterDeviceOperationBroker#handleSendToDeviceMessage 订阅
            .flatMap(msg -&gt; handleMessage(msg)//======================= 见下
                    .onErrorResume(err -&gt; {
                        log.error("handle send to device message error {}", msg, err);
                        return Mono.empty();
                    }))
            .subscribe();
}

</code></pre>
<h3 id="下发消息处理">下发消息处理</h3>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.supports.server.ClusterSendToDeviceMessageHandler#handleMessage</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> private Mono&lt;Void&gt; handleMessage(Message msg) {
    if (!(msg instanceof DeviceMessage)) {
        return Mono.empty();
    }

    DeviceMessage message = ((DeviceMessage) msg);
    if (message.getDeviceId() == null) {
        log.warn("deviceId is null :{}", message);
        return Mono.empty();
    }
    return sessionManager
            .getSession(message.getDeviceId())
            //会话存在则直接发送给会话
            .map(session -&gt; sendTo(session, message))
            //处理会话不存在的消息
            .defaultIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -&gt; sendToUnknownSession(message)))
            .flatMap(Function.identity())
            .contextWrite(TraceHolder.readToContext(Context.empty(), message.getHeaders()));
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.supports.server.ClusterSendToDeviceMessageHandler#sendTo</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> private Mono&lt;Void&gt; sendTo(DeviceSession session, DeviceMessage message) {
        DeviceOperator device;
        //子设备会话都发给网关
        if (session.isWrapFrom(ChildrenDeviceSession.class)) {
            device = session.unwrap(ChildrenDeviceSession.class).getParentDevice();
            if (!(message instanceof ChildDeviceMessage)) {
                ChildDeviceMessage msg = new ChildDeviceMessage();
                msg.setChildDeviceMessage(message);
                msg.setChildDeviceId(message.getDeviceId());
                msg.setDeviceId(device.getDeviceId());
                message = msg;
            }
        } else {
            device = session.getOperator();
        }
        //never happen
        if (null == device) {
            return this
                    .doReply((DeviceOperator) null, createReply(message).error(ErrorCode.CONNECTION_LOST))
                    .then();
        }
        CodecContext context = new CodecContext(device, message, DeviceSession.trace(session));

        return device
                .getProtocol()//拿到协议
                .flatMap(protocol -&gt; protocol.getMessageCodec(context.session.getTransport()))//拿到消息编码器
                .flatMapMany(codec -&gt; codec.encode(context))//消息编码器 编码消息
                .as(create(DeviceTracer.SpanName.encode(device.getDeviceId()),
                           (span, msg) -&gt; span.setAttribute(DeviceTracer.SpanKey.message, msg.toString())))
                //发送给会话
                .map(msg -&gt; context.session.send(msg).then())
                //协议包返回了empty,可能是不支持这类消息
                .defaultIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -&gt; handleUnsupportedMessage(context)))
                .flatMap(Function.identity())
                .onErrorResume(err -&gt; {
                    if (!(err instanceof DeviceOperationException)) {
                        log.error("handle send to device message error {}", context.message, err);
                    }
                    if (!context.alreadyReply) {
                        return doReply(context, createReply(context.message).error(err));
                    }
                    return Mono.empty();
                })
                .then(Mono.defer(() -&gt; handleMessageSent(context)));

    }
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="08100118" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3723410/202511/3723410-20251128211830895-629461286.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="回复处理">回复处理</h3>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.supports.cluster.ClusterDeviceOperationBroker#doReply</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override
protected Mono&lt;Void&gt; doReply(DeviceMessageReply reply) {
    //从队列拿
    RepayableDeviceMessage&lt;?&gt; msg = awaits.remove(getAwaitReplyKey(reply));
    Member member = null;

    if (null != msg) {//拿到发送的服务器
        member = msg.getHeader(Headers.sendFrom)
                    .map(this::getMember)
                    .orElse(null);
    }
    Function&lt;Member, Mono&lt;Void&gt;&gt; handler = _member -&gt; cluster
            .send(_member, io.scalecube.cluster.transport.api.Message
                    .builder()
                    .qualifier(QUALIFIER_REPLY)
                    .data(reply)
                    .build());
    //fast reply
    if (null != member) {//给发送的服务器 回复
        return handler.apply(member);
    }
    return Flux
            .fromIterable(cluster.otherMembers())
            .flatMap(handler)//每个集群成员调一遍???
            .then();
}

</code></pre>
<h2 id="设备状态检查">设备状态检查</h2>
<p>获取设备详情会触发状态检查 <code>/device/instance/HSZ-22A-061-00001/detail</code></p>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.core.defaults.DefaultDeviceOperator#checkState</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">  public Mono&lt;Byte&gt; checkState() {
        return Mono
                .zip(
                        stateChecker
                                // 回调
                                .checkState(this)
                                // 见下 org.jetlinks.supports.cluster.CompositeDeviceStateChecker#checkState
                                .switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -&gt; DEFAULT_STATE_CHECKER.checkState(this)))// 注意: lambda 变量传的是this, 后面会调到自己的 checkState0 方法
                                .defaultIfEmpty(DeviceState.online),
                        this.getState()
                )
                .flatMap(tp2 -&gt; {
                    byte newer = tp2.getT1();
                    byte old = tp2.getT2();
                    if (newer != old) {//
                        log.info("device[{}] state changed from {} to {}", this.getDeviceId(), old, newer);
                        Map&lt;String, Object&gt; configs = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
                        configs.put("state", newer);
                        if (newer == DeviceState.online) {
                            configs.put("onlineTime", System.currentTimeMillis());
                        } else if (newer == DeviceState.offline) {
                            configs.put("offlineTime", System.currentTimeMillis());
                        }
                        return this
                                .setConfigs(configs)//更新, 检查后的状态
                                .thenReturn(newer);
                    }
                    return Mono.just(newer);
                });
    }

</code></pre>

public final Mono&lt;Boolean&gt; isAlive(String deviceId, boolean onlyLocal) {
    Mono&lt;Boolean&gt; localAlive = this
            .getSession(deviceId)// 根据设备ID 找session, 找不到就为false, 最终是离线
            .hasElement();

        return localAlive;
    }
    return localAlive
            .flatMap(alive -&gt; {
                if (alive) {
                    return Reactors.ALWAYS_TRUE;
                }
                return remoteSessionIsAlive(deviceId);
            });
}

        .getDeviceStrategy(deviceId)

<p>以行式存储为例:<br>
<code>org.jetlinks.community.device.service.data.TimeSeriesRowDeviceDataStoreStoragePolicy#queryEachProperties</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Nonnull  
@Override  
public Flux&lt;DeviceProperty&gt; queryEachProperties(@Nonnull String deviceId,  
                                                @Nonnull QueryParamEntity query,  
                                                @Nonnull String... property) {  
  
    return getProductAndMetadataByDevice(deviceId)  
        .flatMapMany(tp2 -&gt; {  
  
            Map&lt;String, PropertyMetadata&gt; propertiesMap = getPropertyMetadata(tp2.getT2(), property)  
                .stream()  
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(PropertyMetadata::getId, Function.identity(), (a, b) -&gt; a));  
            if (propertiesMap.isEmpty()) {  
                return Flux.empty();  
            }  
            return timeSeriesManager  
                .getService(devicePropertyMetric(tp2.getT1().getId()))
                //一条属性行, 必然是聚合查询; 有两个实现, 反正最终都会调到ElasticRestClient的API
                .aggregation(AggregationQueryParam  
                    .of()  
                    .agg(new LimitAggregationColumn("property", "property", Aggregation.TOP, query.getPageSize()))  
                    .groupBy(new LimitGroup("property", "property", propertiesMap.size() * 2)) //按property分组 (一条属性一行的)
                    .filter(query)  
                    .filter(q -&gt; q.where("deviceId", deviceId).in("property", propertiesMap.keySet()))  
                ).map(data -&gt; DeviceProperty  
                    .of(data, data.getString("property").map(propertiesMap::get).orElse(null))  
                    .deviceId(deviceId));  
        });  
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="规则引擎-ruleengine">规则引擎 RuleEngine</h2>

<h3 id="实体到rulemodel">实体到RuleModel</h3>
<p>从数据库到RuleModel</p>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.rule.engine.service.RuleInstanceService#start</code><br>

<pre><code class="language-java">public Mono&lt;Void&gt; start(String id) {  
    return findById(Mono.just(id)) //从数据库找到 规则实体数据
        .flatMap(this::doStart);  
}

private Mono&lt;Void&gt; doStart(RuleInstanceEntity entity) {  
    return Mono.defer(() -&gt; {  
        RuleModel model = entity.toRule(modelParser);//解析为 RuleModel
        return ruleEngine  
            .startRule(entity.getId(), model)  //使用规则引擎 执行规则, 见下
            .then(createUpdate()  
                      .set(RuleInstanceEntity::getState, RuleInstanceState.started)  
                      .where(entity::getId)  
                      .execute()).then();  
    });  
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.rule.engine.defaults.DefaultRuleEngine#startRule</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public Flux&lt;Task&gt; startRule(String instanceId,  
                            RuleModel model) {  
             //ScheduleJobCompiler 调度任务编译器,将规则模型编译成调度任务
    return Flux.fromIterable(new ScheduleJobCompiler(instanceId, model).compile())  
            .flatMap(scheduler::schedule)  
            .collectList()  
            .flatMapIterable(Function.identity())  
            .flatMap(task -&gt; task.start().thenReturn(task));//最后在执行 定时任务
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="核心执行逻辑">核心执行逻辑</h3>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.rule.engine.device.DeviceAlarmTaskExecutorProvider.DeviceAlarmTaskExecutor#doSubscribe</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public Flux&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; doSubscribe(EventBus eventBus) {  
  
    //满足触发条件的输出数据流  
    List&lt;Flux&lt;? extends Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt;&gt; triggerOutputs = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();  
  
    int index = 0;  
  
    //上游节点的输入  
    //定时触发时: 定时节点输出到设备指令节点,设备指令节点输出到当前节点  
    Flux&lt;RuleData&gt; input = context  
        .getInput()  
        .accept()  
        //使用cache,多个定时收到相同的数据  
        //通过header来进行判断具体是哪个触发器触发的,应该还有更好的方式.  
        .replay(0)  
        .refCount(1,Duration.ofMillis(10));  
  
    for (DeviceAlarmRule.Trigger trigger : rule.getTriggers()) {  
        //QL不存在,理论上不会发生  
        ReactorQL ql = triggerQL.get(trigger);  
        if (ql == null) {  
            log.warn("DeviceAlarmRule trigger {} init error", index);  
            continue;        }  
        Flux&lt;? extends Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; datasource;  
  
        int currentIndex = index;  
        //since 1.11 定时触发的不从eventBus订阅  
        if (trigger.getTrigger() == DeviceAlarmRule.TriggerType.timer) {  
            //从上游获取输入进行处理(通常是定时触发发送指令后得到的回复)  
            datasource = input  
                .filter(data -&gt; {  
                    //通过上游输出的header来判断是否为同一个触发规则，还有更好的方式?  
                    return data  
                        .getHeader("triggerIndex")  
                        .map(idx -&gt; CastUtils.castNumber(idx).intValue() == currentIndex)  
                        .orElse(true);  
                })  
                .flatMap(RuleData::dataToMap);  
        }  
        //从事件总线中订阅数据  
        else {  
            String topic = trigger  
                .getType()  
                .getTopic(rule.getProductId(), rule.getDeviceId(), trigger.getModelId());  
  
            //从事件总线订阅数据进行处理  
            Subscription subscription = Subscription.of(  
                "device_alarm:" + rule.getId() + ":" + index++,  
                topic,  
                Subscription.Feature.local  
            );  
            datasource = eventBus  
                .subscribe(subscription, DeviceMessage.class)  
                .map(Jsonable::toJson);  
  
        }  
  
        ReactorQLContext qlContext = ReactorQLContext  
            .ofDatasource((t) -&gt; datasource  
                .doOnNext(map -&gt; {  
                    if (StringUtils.hasText(rule.getDeviceName())) {  
                        map.putIfAbsent("deviceName", rule.getDeviceName());  
                    }  
                    if (StringUtils.hasText(rule.getProductName())) {  
                        map.putIfAbsent("productName", rule.getProductName());  
                    }  
                    map.put("productId", rule.getProductId());  
                    map.put("alarmId", rule.getId());  
                    map.put("alarmName", rule.getName());  
                }));  
        //绑定SQL中的预编译变量  
        trigger.toFilterBinds().forEach(qlContext::bind);  
  
        //启动ReactorQL进行实时数据处理  
        triggerOutputs.add(ql.start(qlContext).map(ReactorQLRecord::asMap));  
    }  
  
    Flux&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; resultFlux = Flux.merge(triggerOutputs);  
  
    //防抖  
    ShakeLimit shakeLimit;  
    if ((shakeLimit = rule.getShakeLimit()) != null) {  
  
        resultFlux = shakeLimit.transfer(  
            resultFlux,  
            (duration, flux) -&gt;  
                StringUtils.hasText(rule.getDeviceId())  
                    //规则已经指定了固定的设备,直接开启时间窗口就行  
                    ? flux.window(duration, scheduler)  
                    //规则配置在设备产品上,则按设备ID分组后再开窗口  
                    //设备越多,消耗的内存越大  
                    : flux  
                    .groupBy(map -&gt; String.valueOf(map.get("deviceId")), Integer.MAX_VALUE)  
                    .flatMap(group -&gt; group.window(duration, scheduler), Integer.MAX_VALUE),  
            (alarm, total) -&gt; alarm.put("totalAlarms", total)  
        );  
    }  
  
    return resultFlux  
        .as(result -&gt; {  
            //有多个触发条件时对重复的数据进行去重,  
            //防止同时满足条件时会产生多个告警记录  
            if (rule.getTriggers().size() &gt; 1) {  
                return result  
                    .as(FluxUtils.distinct(  
                        map -&gt; map.getOrDefault(PropertyConstants.uid.getKey(), ""),  
                        Duration.ofSeconds(1)));  
            }  
            return result;  
        })  
        .flatMap(map -&gt; {  
            @SuppressWarnings("all")  
            Map&lt;String, Object&gt; headers = (Map&lt;String, Object&gt;) map.remove("headers");  
            map.put("productId", rule.getProductId());  
            map.put("alarmId", rule.getId());  
            map.put("alarmName", rule.getName());  
            if (null != rule.getLevel()) {  
                map.put("alarmLevel", rule.getLevel());  
            }  
            if (null != rule.getType()) {  
                map.put("alarmType", rule.getType());  
            }  
            if (StringUtils.hasText(rule.getDeviceName())) {  
                map.putIfAbsent("deviceName", rule.getDeviceName());  
            }  
            if (StringUtils.hasText(rule.getProductName())) {  
                map.putIfAbsent("productName", rule.getProductName());  
            }  
            if (StringUtils.hasText(rule.getDeviceId())) {  
                map.putIfAbsent("deviceId", rule.getDeviceId());  
            }  
            if (!map.containsKey("deviceName") &amp;&amp; map.get("deviceId") != null) {  
                map.putIfAbsent("deviceName", map.get("deviceId"));  
            }  
            if (!map.containsKey("productName")) {  
                map.putIfAbsent("productName", rule.getProductId());  
            }  
            if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {  
                log.debug("发生设备告警:{}", map);  
            }  
  
            //生成告警记录时生成ID，方便下游做处理。  
            map.putIfAbsent("id", IDGenerator.MD5.generate());  
            return eventBus  
                .publish(String.format(  
                    "/rule-engine/device/alarm/%s/%s/%s",  
                    rule.getProductId(),  
                    map.get("deviceId"),  
                    rule.getId()), map)  
                .thenReturn(map);  
  
        });  
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="触发规则事件">触发规则事件</h3>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.rule.engine.defaults.AbstractExecutionContext#fireEvent</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override  
public &lt;T&gt; Mono&lt;T&gt; fireEvent(@Nonnull String event, @Nonnull RuleData data) {  
    //规则自定义配置  
    data.setHeader(RuleConstants.Headers.ruleConfiguration, getJob().getRuleConfiguration());  
    //任务执行器标识  
    data.setHeader(RuleConstants.Headers.jobExecutor, getJob().getExecutor());  
    //模型类型  
    data.setHeader(RuleConstants.Headers.modelType, getJob().getModelType());  
//使用事件总线 publish
    Mono&lt;T&gt; then = eventBus  
            .publish(RuleConstants.Topics.event(job.getInstanceId(), job.getNodeId(), event), data)  
            .doOnSubscribe(ignore -&gt; log.trace("fire job task [{}] event [{}] ", job, event))  
            .then(Mono.empty());  
    Output output = eventOutputs.get(event);  
    if (output != null) {  
        return output  
                .write(data)  
                .then(then);  
    }  
    return then;  
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="自定义协议开发">自定义协议开发</h1>
<h2 id="协议相关接口对象">协议相关接口对象</h2>
<p>协议(ProtocolSupport)主要由 <code>认证器(Authenticator)</code>, <code>消息编解码器(DeviceMessageCodec)</code>,<code>消息发送拦截器(DeviceMessageSenderInterceptor)</code> 以及<code>配置元数据(ConfigMetadata)</code>组成.<br>
见上: [协议相关 (org.jetlinks.core.spi.ProtocolSupportProvider)]</p>
<p>上传时指定的全限定类名, 是<code>org.jetlinks.core.spi.ProtocolSupportProvider</code> 的派生类!<br>
<a href="https://github.com/jetlinks/demo-protocol" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">官方的一个演示例子</a></p>
<p>协议提供商 (ProtocolSupportProvider): 用于创建协议包实例,在发布协议时,将使用此接口的实现类来创建协议包实例.</p>
<p>协议支持 (ProtocolSupport) : 用于解析设备和平台通信报文的插件,同时还对接入协议进行一些描述,如: 接入说明,需要的配置信息,默认物模型等.</p>
<p>编解码 (DeviceMessageCodec): 对设备上报的数据进行解码,翻译为平台定义的统一的设备消息(DeviceMessage).以及将平台下发的消息(指令)DeviceMessage,编码为设备支持的报文.</p>
<p>设备操作器(DeviceOperator): 对一个设备实例的操作接口,可通过此接口获取、设置配置信息,获取物模型等操作.</p>
<p>设备会话 (DeviceSession): 一个设备的连接会话信息,如: TCP,MQTT连接.</p>
<p>设备消息 (DeviceMessage): 平台统一定义的设备消息,如:属性上报(ReportPropertyMessage),功能调用(FunctionInvokeMessage)等.</p>
<p>设备原始消息 (EncodedMessage): 设备端原始的消息,如: MQTT(MqttMessage),HTTP(HttpExchangeMessage)等.</p>
<p><a href="http://doc.jetlinks.cn/dev-guide/protocol-support.html#%E5%90%8D%E8%AF%8D%E8%A7%A3%E9%87%8A" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://doc.jetlinks.cn/dev-guide/protocol-support.html#名词解释</a></p>
<p>ProtocolSupportDefinition: 协议包的定义描述 (例如 jar,script 类型), ProtocolSupportLoaderProvider 用它来加载</p>
<h2 id="认证器">认证器</h2>
<p><strong>谁持有认证器<code>Authenticator</code>?</strong></p>
<p>在 <code>org.jetlinks.core.ProtocolSupport</code> 有两个 <code>authenticate</code>重载方法处理认证;  最终是持有并委托给<code>org.jetlinks.core.defaults.Authenticator</code>这个进行认证<br>
创建在<code>SupportProvider</code> 中</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public Mono&lt;? extends ProtocolSupport&gt; create(ServiceContext context) {
        CompositeProtocolSupport support = new CompositeProtocolSupport();
        support.setId(this.getProtocolId());
        support.setName(this.getProtocolName());
        support.setDescription(this.getProtocolDescription());
        //持有 Authenticator 
        Authenticator authenticator = this.getAuthenticator();
        support.addAuthenticator(DefaultTransport.MQTT, authenticator);
        support.addAuthenticator(DefaultTransport.MQTT_TLS, authenticator);

        DefaultConfigMetadata mqttMetaConfig = this.getMqttMetaConfig();
        support.addConfigMetadata(DefaultTransport.MQTT, mqttMetaConfig);
        support.addConfigMetadata(DefaultTransport.MQTT_TLS, mqttMetaConfig);

        DeviceMessageCodec codec = this.getDeviceMessageCodec();
        support.addMessageCodecSupport(DefaultTransport.MQTT, () -&gt; {
            return Mono.just(codec);
        });
        support.addMessageCodecSupport(DefaultTransport.MQTT_TLS, () -&gt; {
            return Mono.just(codec);
        });
        return Mono.just(support);
    }
</code></pre>
<p>参考 <code>org.jetlinks.core.defaults.CompositeProtocolSupport</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public interface Authenticator {
    /**
     * 对指定对设备进行认证
     * @param request 认证请求
     * @param device  设备
     * @return 认证结果
     */
    Mono&lt;AuthenticationResponse&gt; authenticate(@Nonnull AuthenticationRequest request,
                                              @Nonnull DeviceOperator device);

    /**
     * 在网络连接建立的时候,可能无法获取设备的标识(如:http,websocket等),则会调用此方法来进行认证.
     * 注意: 认证通过后,需要设置设备ID.{@link AuthenticationResponse#success(String)}
     * @param request  认证请求
     * @param registry 设备注册中心
     * @return 认证结果
     */
    default Mono&lt;AuthenticationResponse&gt; authenticate(@Nonnull AuthenticationRequest request,
                                                      @Nonnull DeviceRegistry registry) {
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>什么时候调用认证器<code>Authenticator</code>认证?</strong></p>
<p><code>org.jetlinks.community.network.mqtt.gateway.device.MqttClientDeviceGateway</code> (MQTT Broker)网关没看到调用认证(其实是需要自己调用, 见:[在解编码器上下文]), 但是 (MQTT Servver) 是调用了认证的可以参考下: <code>org.jetlinks.community.network.mqtt.gateway.device.MqttServerDeviceGateway#doStart</code> 的源码</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">
private void doStart() {
        if (disposable != null) {
            disposable.dispose();
        }
        disposable = mqttServer
            //监听连接
            .handleConnection()
            .filter(conn -&gt; {
                //暂停或者已停止时.
                if (!isStarted()) {
                    //直接响应SERVER_UNAVAILABLE
                    conn.reject(MqttConnectReturnCode.CONNECTION_REFUSED_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE);
                    monitor.rejected();
                }
                return isStarted();
            })
            .publishOn(Schedulers.parallel())
            // &lt;!&gt;  处理mqtt连接请求 并处理认证 见下
            .flatMap(this::handleConnection)
            //处理认证结果
            .flatMap(tuple3 -&gt; handleAuthResponse(tuple3.getT1(), tuple3.getT2(), tuple3.getT3()))
            .flatMap(tp -&gt; handleAcceptedMqttConnection(tp.getT1(), tp.getT2(), tp.getT3()), Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            .contextWrite(ReactiveLogger.start("network", mqttServer.getId()))
            .subscribe();

    }


 private Mono&lt;Tuple3&lt;DeviceOperator, AuthenticationResponse, MqttConnection&gt;&gt; handleConnection(MqttConnection connection) {
        //内存不够了
        if (SystemUtils.memoryIsOutOfWatermark()) {
            //直接拒绝,响应SERVER_UNAVAILABLE,不再处理此连接
            connection.reject(MqttConnectReturnCode.CONNECTION_REFUSED_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE);
            return Mono.empty();
        }
        return Mono
            .justOrEmpty(connection.getAuth())
            .flatMap(auth -&gt; {
                // new MQTT 认证请求对象
                MqttAuthenticationRequest request = new MqttAuthenticationRequest(connection.getClientId(),
                                                                                  auth.getUsername(),
                                                                                  auth.getPassword(),
                                                                                  getTransport());
                return supportMono
                    //使用自定义协议来认证; &lt;!&gt;调用 ProtocolSupport 委托给 Authenticator 认证
                    .map(support -&gt; support.authenticate(request, registry))
                    //没有指定自定义协议,则使用clientId对应的设备进行认证.
                    .defaultIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -&gt; registry
                        .getDevice(connection.getClientId())
                        .flatMap(device -&gt; device.authenticate(request))))
                    .flatMap(Function.identity())
                    //如果认证结果返回空,说明协议没有设置认证,或者认证返回不对,默认返回BAD_USER_NAME_OR_PASSWORD,防止由于协议编写不当导致mqtt任意访问的安全问题.
                    .switchIfEmpty(Mono.fromRunnable(() -&gt; connection.reject(MqttConnectReturnCode.CONNECTION_REFUSED_BAD_USER_NAME_OR_PASSWORD)));
            })
            .flatMap(resp -&gt; {
                //认证响应可以自定义设备ID,如果没有则使用mqtt的clientId
                String deviceId = StringUtils.isEmpty(resp.getDeviceId()) ? connection.getClientId() : resp.getDeviceId();
                //认证返回了新的设备ID,则使用新的设备
                return registry
                    .getDevice(deviceId)
                    .map(operator -&gt; Tuples.of(operator, resp, connection))
                    //设备不存在,应答IDENTIFIER_REJECTED
                    .switchIfEmpty(Mono.fromRunnable(() -&gt; connection.reject(MqttConnectReturnCode.CONNECTION_REFUSED_IDENTIFIER_REJECTED)))
                    ;
            })
            //设备认证错误,拒绝连接
            .onErrorResume((err) -&gt; Mono.fromRunnable(() -&gt; {
                log.error("MQTT连接认证[{}]失败", connection.getClientId(), err);
                //监控信息
                monitor.rejected();
                //应答SERVER_UNAVAILABLE
                connection.reject(MqttConnectReturnCode.CONNECTION_REFUSED_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE);
            }))
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.parallel());
    }


</code></pre>

        return Mono.just(metadata);
    }

    @Override

    }
